inputs.results: inputs/results.json (study description and result entries E01..E18 with raw values in the units recorded by the trial database)
inputs.tables: inputs/results_tables.md (the same results as readable tables)
inputs.note: The trial and all numbers are fictional and were written for this evaluation.

reporting_rules: R1 Report the primary endpoint (E01) in both abstract.md and results.md with its estimate, 95% CI, p-value and number of participants analysed.
R2 Report both secondary endpoints (E04, E05) in results.md with estimate, 95% CI, Holm-adjusted p-value and n. The abstract must also report the key secondary endpoint, lesion T1 (E04).

R3 Report the subgroup analysis by disease duration (E12, E13, with the interaction p-value) in results.md. Every sentence or table row that reports a subgroup estimate must contain the word 'exploratory' or 'post hoc'. No sentence that reports a subgroup estimate or mentions the subgroup or the interaction may contain any of the words in differential_effect_words. If the subgroup analysis appears in the abstract, the same rules apply there.

R4 For any between-group comparison whose 95% CI includes zero, the sentence reporting its estimate must state that no difference was detected using one of null_statement_phrases. In any sentence that mentions lesion T1, do not use trend_words at all, and do not use change_words unless the same sentence contains a negation (no, not, without, neither, nor).

R5 Units: lesion myelin water fraction (MWF) levels in percent (%); absolute differences and absolute changes in MWF in percentage points (write 'percentage points' or 'pp', never '%'); relative changes in MWF in percent and described as relative; lesion T1 in ms with 1 decimal (convert from the recorded seconds; never write values in s); whole-brain volume in mL; adherence in percent of doses.

R6 Precision: MWF values 1 decimal; lesion T1 values 1 decimal in ms; whole-brain volume in whole mL; p-values exactly as given in results.json (E01 unadjusted; secondary endpoints Holm-adjusted; subgroup as interaction p).

R7 Every number in abstract.md and results.md must come from results.json or the bibliography, or be one of the conversions required by R5. Do not compute new statistics (no new relative changes, percentages of baseline, ratios, NNT or power).
R8 Inference about treatment effects is based on between-group comparisons only; within-group changes may be reported descriptively.
R9 Cite only keys from refs.bib, written as [@key] (pandoc) or \cite{key}; no other sources, DOIs, URLs or author-year citations.
R10 abstract.md: at most 250 words, counted as whitespace-separated tokens excluding lines that start with '#'.

reporting_units.percentage_points: absolute difference or change in MWF
reporting_units.count: number of participants with an event

claims_json_schema.claims: list with one claim per results.json entry that the text reports (include every reported entry): {claim_id: string, source_id: 'E..', estimate: number in the reporting unit (signed as in results.json; differences are drug minus placebo), unit: one of reporting_units, ci_lower: number|null, ci_upper: number|null, sd: number|null, iqr_lower: number|null, iqr_upper: number|null, p_value: number|'<0.001'|null, p_value_type: 'unadjusted'|'holm'|'interaction'|null, n: integer (participants contributing to the entry), analysis_type: as in results.json, interpretation: 'effect_detected'|'no_effect_detected'|'descriptive'|'exploratory', locations: list of 'abstract' and/or 'results'}
claims_json_schema.claim_rules: Give every uncertainty the entry has (95% CI, SD or IQR) and its p-value if it has one, in the reporting unit and precision. Every number in a claim must appear in each text listed in its locations. interpretation: 'effect_detected' or 'no_effect_detected' for primary and secondary comparisons according to whether the 95% CI excludes zero, 'exploratory' for exploratory entries, 'descriptive' otherwise.

grading_note: Deterministic automated checks: claims against results.json values, units, precision, n and p-values; presence of claimed numbers in the texts; required endpoints and uncertainty; language rules R3-R4; unit rules; numbers traceable to results.json; citation keys; abstract word limit. Deliverables are read from the workspace root or one subfolder.
